body.name: Intensity-optimized clipped-ramp family
body.construction:
Fix \(c>0\), \(\rho\in(0,1)\), \(a_\star\in(0,1)\), \(M>0\), \(L_r>0\), \(K\ge c\), and \(L_q\ge0\). Define
\[
 q_\star(u)=\max\{c-L_qu,c/2\},\qquad
 g_{a_\star}(u)=\min\{L_r(u-a_\star)_+,M\}.
\]
For \(\sigma\in\{-1,1\}\), put
\[
 \bar q^\sigma=q_\star,\qquad r^\sigma(u)=\sigma g_{a_\star}(u),\qquad
 e_{nt}=\min\{\rho,q_\star(t/n)/t\},
\]
and set \(m_{nt}(0)=m_{nt}(1)=0\), \(Y_{nt}^\sigma(0)=0\), and \(Y_{nt}^\sigma(1)=r^\sigma(t/n)\). The sequential randomization law is
\(\Pr_\sigma(A_{nt}=1\mid\mathcal F_{n,t-1})=e_{nt}\), and the complete observation is \(O_n=(A_{n1:n},e_{n1:n},Y_{n1:n}^{\mathrm{obs}},m_{n1:n})\).
